narrativeProgression.description: The man playfully acknowledges the 'ops' who oppose him.
He defines the 'ops' as those who oppose change and offer negativity without solutions.
He emphasizes his determination to win the primary and invites viewers to an event on December 7th.
He reiterates his commitment to winning and doing 'everything' necessary.
The woman asks if he expects higher voter turnout due to frustration with recent elections, prompting the man to discuss the apathy and frustration he has observed.
The man shares anecdotes about his interactions with constituents who are frustrated but have given up hope.
He reinforces his solution-focused approach and commitment to winning by any legal means.
The woman playfully suggests 'celebrity endorsements' as a strategy, to which the man reiterates his commitment to legal tactics.

youtube_description: 209 Talk Election Season: Caroleta Love interviews Stockton City Council District 6 candidate, Jason Lee. Section 315 of the Communications Act is known as the equal opportunities requirement (commonly referred to as the "equal time" rule).  This law provides that when a broadcast station allows any legally qualified candidate—whether for federal, state, or local office—to use its facilities, it must provide equal opportunities to all other legally qualified candidates for the same office. As such, KWDC has offered the opportunity for a one hour interview all candidates in the Stockton City Council District 6 race.
